## Why This Is Asked

This question evaluates cross-cloud RBAC, privileged access management, and external identity provisioning—critical skills for securing data platform workloads at enterprise scale.

## Key Concepts
- Azure AD Privileged Identity Management (PIM) for just-in-time admin access
- Conditional Access policies for MFA and device compliance
- SCIM provisioning to sync Azure AD groups to Databricks workspace roles
- Access Reviews for automated expiry and access recertification
- Audit trails: Azure AD sign-in logs, Conditional Access logs, Databricks audit logs
- Rollback strategies for misconfiguration scenarios

## Architecture Flow
```
┌─────────────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐     ┌─────────────────┐
│  Contractor     │────▶│  Azure AD PIM    │────▶│  Conditional    │
│  requests       │     │  (eligible       │     │  Access         │
│  activation     │     │   group)         │     │  (MFA+Device)   │
└─────────────────┘     └──────────────────┘     └─────────────────┘
                                                         │
                                                         ▼
┌─────────────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐     ┌─────────────────┐
│  Databricks     │◀────│  SCIM            │◀────│  Azure AD       │
│  Admin Role     │     │  Provisioning    │     │  Group Member   │
└─────────────────┘     └──────────────────┘     └─────────────────┘
                                                         │
                                                         ▼
                                                 ┌─────────────────┐
                                                 │  Access Review  │
                                                 │  (auto-revoke)  │
                                                 └─────────────────┘
```

- What happens if the contractor loses device compliance mid-assignment?

questions.explanation: ## Architectural Flow Azure AD authenticates first, then App Proxy pre-authentication runs. Target CA policies to the enterprise application object in Azure AD—not the App Proxy connector—to ensure CA evaluates before App Proxy. ## Sign-in Risk Risk is evaluated per authentication step. For JIT admin role elevation, create a separate CA policy targeting the Azure AD Role Management service, or use PIM to handle Just-in-Time elevation separately. ## Entitlement Management Controls access entitlement duration (max 365 days). JIT uses shorter durations like 30 minutes. Assignment requires approval. Policy expiration triggers automatic de-provisioning when the session ends. ## Device Compliance Intune device compliance policies must be assigned to device groups containing admin accounts. Require hybrid Azure AD join for on-premises-managed devices, or compliant unmanaged for BYOD. ## Trusted Locations Configure named locations with internal IP ranges (RFC 1918 addresses) to exclude admin networks from MFA requirements. ## Validation Always validate in a separate dev/test environment before production.
